steps.label: Install and local data locations
steps.summary: Choose where the app and city data live on this machine.
steps.detail: The default locations stay under your current Windows user account and can be changed before local services are installed.
steps.next_action: Choose install, data, and backup folders.

steps.label: Module selection
steps.summary: Townlight Records is selected by default and Townlight Core is locked on.
steps.detail: You can choose another profile, but only modules that have finished testing for this Townlight version can be added.
steps.next_action: Review the Townlight Records module set.

steps.label: City profile
steps.summary: Enter the city name, state, time zone, records contact, and clerk contact.
steps.detail: The city profile personalizes notices, records responses, code guidance, and audit context.

steps.label: First admin user
steps.summary: Create the first Townlight admin before staff work begins.
steps.detail: The first admin owns setup, model download, users, roles, backup settings, and recovery contact information.
steps.next_action: Create the first admin user, then sign in with that local passcode before continuing setup.

steps.label: Backup default
steps.summary: Choose the default local backup folder.
steps.detail: Backup is configured before city work begins so records, packets, notices, code imports, and audit entries have a recovery path.

steps.label: Local AI model download
steps.summary: Choose whether to configure optional local AI now or continue without it.
steps.detail: Records workflows do not require model weights. A signed-in Townlight admin may defer local AI, or download the pinned Gemma 4 12B model with resumable download and checksum verification.
steps.next_action: Continue without local AI, or download and verify the pinned local model weights.

steps.label: Health verification
steps.summary: Verify local services, storage, backup, and any configured local model before staff work.
steps.detail: The health step checks local services and storage. Model verification and loading are required only when local AI has not been deferred.

steps.label: Finish and lifecycle entry points
steps.summary: Open Townlight and keep repair, backup, and uninstall reachable.
steps.detail: The finish screen links the app, System Health, repair, backup, and uninstall so the same product surface owns the lifecycle.
steps.next_action: Open Townlight after all setup checks pass.
